title: Connexions de Gauss-Manin et équations de Picard-Fuchs. Opération de Cartier : copies de tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), tiré à part (1981), notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical error. In the first line the machine transcription's '(f'^2/f^2)^2 dt^2' is wrong. The image reads (f'_t/f)^2 dt^2, i.e. (f'/f)^2 dt^2, which is correct. The final identity (dg/g)^2/(df/f)^2 = (dg/df)^2/(g/f)^2 is correct.

ideas.what: Squared logarithmic differential as a quadratic differential, and the ratio E(f,g) of two such differentials (square of the logarithmic derivative / elasticity of g with respect to f)
ideas.modern_name: logarithmic derivative / elasticity; ratio of quadratic differentials

deep.surprise_reason: Elementary scratch calculus with logarithmic derivatives. The listed properties are not even written out, and nothing here goes beyond the classical.
transcription_corrections: First line: '(f'^2/f^2)^2 dt^2' should read '(f'_t / f)^2 dt^2' (i.e. (f'/f)^2 dt^2).
'On a a) b) [-c)-] d) e) -- On prend [?] donc [?]' — the second clause is hard to read; possibly 'On prend donc' / 'On prend dans'.
The crossed-out bottom item is an illegible blue-ink scribble resembling 'd/dx G_a(c)'; it is struck out and has no content.
